create_autoencoder_model: create a Haiku autoencoder model with encoder-decoder layers for MNIST image reconstruction
build_autoencoder_loss: build an autoencoder loss function with sigmoid cross-entropy and optional L2 regularization
run_autoencoder_experiment: run an MNIST autoencoder experiment using the AutoencoderMnistExperiment class with jaxline
test_autoencoder_forward: test the autoencoder forward pass by applying parameters to flattened MNIST image batches
review_autoencoder_loss_stats: review the autoencoder loss computation returning loss value and statistics dictionary with MSE
